text:
Use `git show --stat` for a summary:

```bash
git show --stat HEAD
```

Shows file names and number of lines added/removed.

For full diff:

```bash
git diff HEAD~1 HEAD
```

Shows actual changes.

For file status only:

```bash
git show --name-status HEAD
```

Shows additions/deletions/renames/modified.

Shortest:

```bash
git log --name-only -1
```
